_comment: Where each corpus document comes from. This file is the only place a source URL
is written down, and ingest/manifest.py copies the url and retrieved_on into each
RULES, same discipline as runlog.pricing.RateCard applies to model prices:
- licence is read from the publisher's own BOOK-LEVEL licensing page, never from
a chapter footer and never from an aggregator. introcs is the live example:
its book-level page says CC BY 4.0 while individual chapter footers say
CC BY-NC-SA. The book-level page governs.
- pdf_sha256 is filled by whoever downloads the file, from the file they
actually downloaded. Never copied from another machine's manifest.
- retrieved_on is the date of that download, ISO 8601.
- a null field is an honest 'not recorded yet'. Do not guess one.
Nulls below are UNRECORDED, not unknown-forever: fill them on the next fetch.

introcs.title: Introduction to Computer Science
introcs.licence_note: Book-level page governs. Some chapter footers state CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; docs/16 records this as a publisher template inconsistency.

physics1.title: University Physics Volume 1
physics1.known_issue: Orphan-punctuation rate 113.5/1k lines. Equations are lost by text extraction, which is content loss and not formatting loss. Disqualified as primary document (docs/16).

axler.title: Linear Algebra Done Right, 4th edition
axler.licence_note: Confirmed 28 Aug 2026 against the author’s own site, which states "Creative Commons BY-NC". The 4.0 version marker is retained from docs/16 and is [UNVERIFIED] — the site states the licence family, not the version.
axler.known_issue: No learning objectives and no key-terms blocks, so document-native ground truth cannot be extracted. Strongest prerequisite structure of the three; O5 only (docs/16).
